notes.title: #2 Update and Progress
notes.notes:
Thank you for your continued support and valuable feedback!
After thorough analysis and consideration, our development team has identified that most current issues stem from limitations in the legacy UI framework.

To address this, we are fully committed to rebuilding a brand-new UI framework, focusing on the following improvements:

Comprehensive upgrades to mouse/keyboard/controller compatibility

Optimized UI interaction logic for smoother operation

Enhanced gameplay experience, including adjusted pacing for early/mid-game progression and refined difficulty curve

As this update involves a complete low-level framework, we require additional time for development and stability testing. I sincerely apologize for the delayed release .

Our team remains dedicated to delivering the best possible experience. 
Thank you for your understanding and patience!

With gratitude,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036987/6aca37fb00e22c379c7f5df07bff4c9c88d27843.png[/img]

notes.title: 1.1.4 Update Notes & 2.0 Update Plan
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Adjusted early-stage enemies and optimized process experience.
[*] Added teammate cooperative execution: at the moment of the second execution hit, pressing the execution button again will have teammates assist in the attack.
[*] Simplified perfect counter-trigger conditions, making it easier to trigger the perfect counter and knock back light enemies.
[*] Optimized some of the player's basic attack hitboxes.
[*] Increased Blaze value rewards, reduced player stamina consumption when counting in combat, encouraging more aggressive play.
[*] Optimized some material shaders.
[*] Fixed UI interaction bugs with the warehouse and shop (some bugs are caused by the old UI framework, which will be fixed in the upcoming major 2.0 version update).
[/list]

Thank you to all players for their continued play and support. 
We plan to release a major 2.0 update in early March:
[list]
[*] Update and optimize the art style of multiple character portraits.
[*] Update the UI framework, add animations, and beautify.
[*] Optimize overall process levels, including tower levels and the six hero levels, streamlining and optimizing the experience.
[*] Provide toggle options for certain effects, such as camera shake.
[*] Add controller vibration support for certain interactions.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.1.0 Update Preview | Free Game + Free DLC | Community Appreciation
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Thank you for your continuous play and support. Your encouragement and positive review are the greatest motivation for us to keep improving and pushing forward.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036987/bf634da780ae90a8844e3537aa2f9cbe10dd1cb5.gif[/img]
[h2]Free DLC[/h2]
We will soon be releasing the 1.1.0 update, which will be divided into two phases:

[list]
[*] New Characters (2 characters) and new Spells（These days）
[*] New Weapon Kit: Dagger（These days）
[*] High-difficulty Levels (scheduled for public release in mid-December)
[/list]

[h2]Free Game[/h2]
Our team has recently released [b]Arisen Force: Life Devotee[/b], a free Souls-like ARPG with high difficulty. The game simplifies some aspects of equipment progression and focuses more on enemy and combat design, making the battles more interactive and challenging. Multi-language support is currently being translated.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3279120/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036987/058ea2c9fe7da13876be7167c2b45964a460b193.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Soundtrack[/h2]
We have released the game’s official [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3292130/Arisen_Force_HeroTest_Soundtrack/]soundtrack[/url]. After downloading, the MP3 format is available for playback on Steam, while the WAV format can be found in the parent folder at the same path.

[h2]Technical Aspects[/h2]
Since the game's release, our team has been working hard to maintain and update the game, gradually improving its stability and adding many new features, such as remappable keys and a trainning mode. We are also aware of certain UI interaction issues that persist on specific devices. This is due to our limited hardware, which prevents us from replicating and pinpointing the exact cause of these issues. As a result, our tech team has decided to completely rebuild the UI’s underlying logic in a more universal way to better support a wider range of devices and players.

[h2]Community Appreciation[/h2]
We still remember the initial reports from some players regarding a bug where their characters had abnormally high stats. Through email correspondence, beta testing, and save file submissions, we were able to locate the issue: certain devices (possibly related to memory) were parsing our game’s floating-point values as integers, leading to unintended stat boosts. We have now resolved this issue.

When bugs are related to hardware, fixing and addressing them becomes more difficult. If you encounter any unexpected issues, please feel free to send us feedback via email. If possible, please include screenshots and compressed save files, as they are crucial for fixing and identifying the problem.

Save file path: C:\Users\{Username}\AppData\LocalLow\ArisenForce\HeroTest

[h2]Special Thanks[/h2]
Finally, we'd like to thank all players once again. Your positive reviews are the greatest support for our development team and the warmest encouragement for us to continue working on new updates.

Thank you,
The Arisen Force Team

notes.notes:

[list]
[*]  [b]Optimized key binding , separating confirm, cancel, interact, and jump functions, allowing players to freely bind keys.[/b]
[*]  Key adjustments also apply to the UI interface, where adjusting confirm and cancel can switch to familiar JRPG operational habits.
[*]  Added a function to the left mouse button for normal attack input and to the right mouse button for dodge input, suitable for keyboard and mouse players.
[/list]

Currently, there may be some bugs with the UI icons display, which will be fixed in a subsequent patch.
-------------------------------------------------
Change key bindings at Main Menu - Settings - Key Binding (fourth option).

Thank you for your patience. During this time, we have deeply optimized parts of the original input system, separated some complex logic, and supported players to customize various logics and key bindings. We hope you like it and appreciate your support and understanding.
